audience: teams that host their sites on servers managed with Ploi

useCases.title: Find servers low on disk space
useCases.text: List the servers of the account. Read the CPU, memory and disk figures of one server. Monitoring must be installed on that server.

useCases.title: Review sites and deployments on a server
useCases.text: List the sites on one server and open one site. Then list its deployments, newest first.

useCases.title: Read logs when a site misbehaves
useCases.text: List the latest log entries of a site and open one to read its full content. Check the server activity log for recent changes.

useCases.title: Check certificates, databases and daemons
useCases.text: List the SSL certificates of a site, the databases on a server and the background processes of a server.

useCases.title: Start a site deployment
useCases.text: Start a deployment of one site and get its deployment id. The site's deploy script runs on the live server. Each call starts a new deploy.
